discovery_notes: Follow-up 5 of B028 (DLR LE 2016). 30 standard WebSearch calls, blocked domains passed. New: Alice and Finding Nemo Character Connection puzzle sets (12 Nemo designs from a fan blog with per-design editions), Autopia PODH, Star Wars POTM Mustafar, DVC 25 Years, Viva Navidad 2016 x2, Star Wars Half Marathon 2016 set, DCA 15th CM pins. Resellers (yourwdwstore, distradingpins4u, collectrandom, justdisney, bonanza) ignored. No holds released; three holds added.
